title: Build quality impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly praise the G60's solid overall build quality, with many other sampled mentions too incomplete to determine sentiment and one negative example that is about the built-in Spotify app rather than physical build quality.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the vehicle as solidly built with excellent or very good overall build quality.

negative.summary: The only negative review in the sample concerns an unreliable built-in Spotify application, which appears only loosely related to build quality.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention quality or build quality but are too fragmentary or ambiguous to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: The sampled negative example appears to be about software reliability rather than physical build quality, so the topic cluster may include some loosely related content.
Many undetermined fragments are truncated or too brief to interpret confidently, which limits detail on unclear mentions.
The examples are a stratified sample and are not representative estimates of all G60 reviews.
